exam.name: Modulprüfung European and Global Legal History (030362 VO + 030152 PUE)
exam.format: Module examination for the 030362 lecture course. It is examined from the list 'What to read for the exam' — 24 topics, each with a lecture and required reading. The questions are source-based: an extract (a treaty, a constitution, a period text) followed by several open sub-questions — who, when, what follows from it and how it connects to the later development. See 'Second Exam.pdf' in the exercise course (030152), which also has the answers.
